label: last copy steps of short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, near the end of short sequences. For L=3 it fires on every final step (t=5, outputting orig(2)) with precision 1.0 and the largest activations (about 20% of activations but 51% of mass; top examples all of this form). For L=4 it fires on the last two copy steps (recall_idx 2 and 3), but only on about 28% of them, modulated by the input token (o, r, w, 2, c, d, 0, a, 3, i, m are favoured); this token gating is only approximately captured. Never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on recall_idx 0-1; rare weak firing on later copy steps of longer sequences (L>=5, about 6% of mass). The simple rule (L<=4) & (recall_idx>=2) covers 94% of mass but has precision 0.34.
